in_arabic.name: Fizzi
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fizzi هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Originates from the Arabic word 'fiz' which means joy or happiness. In Urdu, the name Fizzi is derived from the word 'fizaa' which means a canopy or umbrella, symbolizing protection and shelter.

in_urdu.name: Fizzi

in_urdu.long_meaning: Fizzi ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Originates from the Arabic word 'fiz' which means joy or happiness. In Urdu, the name Fizzi is derived from the word 'fizaa' which means a canopy or umbrella, symbolizing protection and shelter.
